name: math-llm-mini
description: Character-level GPT in TypeScript and TensorFlow.js, with a Vite training UI and Node CLI.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @math-llm/tiny-llm && npm run build -w @math-llm/tiny-web
scripts.train:vi-chat: npm run prepare:vi-chat && npm run train:tiny -- --corpus train-data/vi-chat-training.txt --steps 1000 --resume models/vi-foundation-cli --out models/vi-chat
